implementation.name: main
implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Acts as the entry point for the application, orchestrating user account management by calling add_user, update_user_email, and deactivate_user on the UserManager instance.
implementation.pseudo_code:
Initialize UserManager and UserStatistics
Add several users with add_user
Display statistics
Deactivate a user with deactivate_user
Display updated statistics
Update a user's email with update_user_email
Display updated user info

implementation.name: add_user
implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Implements adding new users, enforces unique usernames, and validates age range. Directly fulfills the requirement for adding users and validation.
implementation.pseudo_code:
IF username exists in users:
    RAISE error (duplicate username)
IF age < 0 OR age > 150:
    RAISE error (invalid age)
Add user to users dictionary with email, age, active=True
RETURN True

implementation.name: update_user_email
implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Implements updating a user's email address. Checks if the user exists before updating.
implementation.pseudo_code:
IF username not in users:
    RAISE error (user not found)
Set user's email to new_email
RETURN True

implementation.name: deactivate_user
implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Implements deactivating a user account. Checks if the user exists before deactivating.
implementation.pseudo_code:
IF username not in users:
    RAISE error (user not found)
Set user's active status to False
RETURN True

implementation.name: get_active_users
implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Maintains and retrieves the collection of active users, supporting the requirement to maintain a collection of users.
implementation.pseudo_code:
FOR each username, data in users:
    IF data['active'] is True:
        INCLUDE username in result list
RETURN list of active usernames

implementation.name: main
implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Entry point of the application. Initializes UserManager and UserStatistics, adds users, and prints statistics by calling UserStatistics methods.
implementation.pseudo_code:
Initialize UserManager
Initialize UserStatistics with UserManager
Add several users
Print average age and age groups using UserStatistics
Deactivate a user
Print updated statistics for active users

implementation.name: UserStatistics.get_average_age
implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Calculates the average age of active users by retrieving active users from UserManager and averaging their ages.
implementation.pseudo_code:
Get list of active users from UserManager
If no active users, return 0
For each active user:
    Retrieve user data
    Add user's age to total
Return total age divided by number of active users

implementation.name: UserStatistics.get_user_count_by_age_group
implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Categorizes active users into age groups (youth, adult, senior) and counts the number in each group.
implementation.pseudo_code:
Initialize age group counters for youth, adult, senior
Get list of active users from UserManager
For each active user:
    Retrieve user data
    If age < 18: increment youth
    Else if age < 65: increment adult
    Else: increment senior
Return age group counters

implementation.name: UserManager.get_active_users
implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Returns a list of usernames for all users marked as active. Used by UserStatistics to filter users for statistics.
implementation.pseudo_code:
For each user in users dictionary:
    If user is active:
        Add username to list
Return list of active usernames
